planPhases.title: Add updateUser action to AuthContext
planPhases.notes: Added updateUser(user: AuthUser) to AuthContextValue interface and AuthProvider. Updates both in-memory state (setUser) and localStorage.

planPhases.title: Create ProtectedRoute component
planPhases.notes: Created src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx. Uses useAuthContext to check token; redirects to /login via Navigate if unauthenticated, renders children otherwise. Both protectedRoute.test.tsx tests pass.

planPhases.title: Create ProfilePage component
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx. View mode shows username, email, and member-since date with an Edit Profile button. Edit mode has username/email fields pre-filled, a Change Password toggle, Cancel/Save buttons. Save sends PATCH /auth/me with only changed fields; if nothing changed, no request is made. On success calls updateUser and dismisses form. All 8 profilePage tests pass.

planPhases.title: Wire /profile route in App.tsx
planPhases.notes: Added ProfilePage and ProtectedRoute imports to App.tsx. Added <Route path="profile"> inside AppLayout routes, wrapping ProfilePage with ProtectedRoute. All 42 tests pass and build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run tests and verify all pass
planPhases.notes: All 42 tests pass across 12 test files. Build succeeds (tsc + vite, 70 modules transformed).
